failedAttempts.recovery: Stopped only the recorded binary/profile, preserved the trace and profile, launched the same Chrome version with a new isolated profile, passed the unchanged affected journey, and reran the full browser gate.
failedAttempts.limits: The trace identifies the failed browser request, not the cause of host buffer exhaustion. No test retry policy, assertion, timeout or application code was changed.

limitations: No new actual DevTools qualification, physical laptop/phone or Safari observations, or participant results.

The first full browser attempt had one JavaScript request fail with ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE. Its trace proves the failed request, not the host exhaustion cause; the unchanged focused journey and complete suite passed with a fresh owned browser.
Tarball consumer checks do not establish npm publication or registry consumer behavior. Both 0.1.1 public metadata endpoints returned 404 at the recorded observation.
Local prepared headers do not emulate Vercel routing, CDN, alias assignment or deployment protection. GitHub CI and hosted outcomes are separate later observations.
Raw logs and traces stay local; only this sanitized receipt is committed.
invalidators: Changed source, tests, fixture/harness/configuration, lockfile or candidate bytes invalidate the affected observation.
Browser/OS/toolchain changes require reconciliation; a newer contradictory result invalidates the affected pass.
Publication and hosted state must be refreshed for their exact candidate and target; local success cannot establish those states.
